messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-0427 — severity: P1 — summary: gpu-node-87 kubelet NotReady (zone-us-west-2a)
incident-bot: Alert details: host=gpu-node-87, probe=kubelet, symptom=NodeNotReady, recent-events=kernel_oops(3), last_seen=2024-06-05T14:30:20Z, runbook=/runbooks/gpu-node-unready.md
pagerduty-bot: Incident created: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-0427 :rotating_light:
alicia (oncall): acked PD-0427 — taking initial ownership. starting triage. can someone grab serial console?
ben (sre): on it — pulling serial logs and trying to ssh into mgmt. if kubelet is flapping we'll cordon first.
charlie (infra): i see repeated kernel OOPS in the logs, looks nvme-related: "nvme: abort CMD" x5 in last 2 mins. tagging infra for hw check.
dana (support): dvcs 1121 reported timeouts for inference jobs ~14:28-14:34, looks like 4 customer requests failed with 503. capturing impact for postmortem.
alicia (oncall): ok cordoning node now to stop new pods landing: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-87`
ben (sre): running drain with graceful timeout 60s: ```kubectl drain gpu-node-87 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60```
ben (sre): drain started — some long-lived sessions, one GPU job still terminating (pid 8421). I'll force after 60s if it doesn't exit.
incident-bot: PD-0427 update: Escalation step 1 triggered after 5m without resolution; paging escalation-list: infra-senior, platform-lead.
charlie (infra): attaching serial console capture: ```[   14.27.58] kernel: nvme nvme0: I/O 1234 QID 0 timeout, aborting``` and ```[   14.28.03] kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: fatal exception```
alicia (oncall): kernel panic confirmed. this is not just kubelet flapping. marking node as offline and requesting rack tech to pull host. creating incident doc now.
dana (support): logging customer impact: 4/87 requests failed for two tenants (acme-inc, beta-saas). estimated users affected: 12 active requests at time. notifying account reps.
ben (sre): forced pod eviction completed. most pods rescheduled to other nodes in the cluster, a small percentage retried and succeeded. routing layer reported transient increased latency during reschedule ~300-800ms.
charlie (infra): escalated to hardware team with serial logs. tech will attempt NVMe reseat and full power-cycle. ETA 20-30m. ordering replacement SSD if failure confirmed.
alicia (oncall): created incident page: https://incidents.redwood/PD-0427 — notes: kernel panic -> nvme -> node offline -> partial customer impact; severity P1. adding oncall handoff notes.
ben (sre): adding mitigation: enable fallback pool for GPU workloads to avoid queuing. `kubectl apply -f fallback-scheduler.yaml` done. traffic rules updated.
dana (support): customer outreach draft ready, posting to affected customers in 10m after confirm of impact window. please add any technical notes to incident doc.
incident-bot: PD-0427 — acknowledgement reminder scheduled in 10m.
charlie (infra): tech confirmed reseat failed, device SMART shows critical reallocated sectors. replacement ordered. host will remain down until replacement or we reprovision onto spare hardware.
alicia (oncall): ok switching to 1-hour handoff window. ben, do you want to own follow-up and CYA with ops, i'll take incident comms and customer notes.
ben (sre): i'll keep ownership of mitigation and remediation, will update incident doc with timeline and actions taken. handoff at 15:45 UTC.
dana (support): adding timeline to support playbook and setting calendar reminder for follow-up.
alicia (oncall): final note for now — customers affected were retried automatically, no data lost, degraded availability for ~6 minutes. will update when hardware replacement confirmed. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PD-0427 updated: status=investigating -> mitigated_by_reroute; next_action=hardware-replacement; responders=[alicia,ben,charlie,dana]
ben (sre): logging commands used for repro and mitigation in incident doc: ```kubectl cordon gpu-node-87
kubectl drain gpu-node-87 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
kubectl apply -f fallback-scheduler.yaml
systemctl status kubelet # showed crash loop after kernel oops
journalctl -k -b -1 | grep nvme```
charlie (infra): hardware ticket created TK-9082, ETA replacement hardware 2 business days (expedite requested).
alicia (oncall): handoff note: if replacement delayed, schedule permanent reprovision to spare host; owners: ben infra, charlie hardware. leaving channel, ping for urgent updates.
ben (sre): ack handoff. will post follow-up status updates here and close thread when resolved.
incident-bot: PD-0427 — incident handoff recorded at 1718766000.
